mapper.select: SELECT mno, mname, mid, mpasswd, mzipcode, maddr, maddrdetail, mbirth, mgender, mtel, memail, mdate, mauth FROM member WHERE mid = #{mid} AND mpasswd = #{mpasswd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( mno, mname, mid, mpasswd, mzipcode, maddr, maddrdetail, mbirth, mgender, mtel, memail, mdate, mauth ) VALUES ( member_seq.NEXTVAL, #{mname}, #{mid}, #{mpasswd}, #{mzipcode}, #{maddr}, #{maddrdetail}, #{mbirth}, #{mgender}, #{mtel}, #{memail}, SYSDATE, 'USER' )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM member ORDER BY mno DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET mname = #{mname}, mzipcode = #{mzipcode}, maddr = #{maddr}, maddrdetail = #{maddrdetail}, mtel = #{mtel}, memail = #{memail} WHERE mno = #{mno}
